pillars.heading: Imagination,
pillars.body: To transform imagination into exceptional paper artistry and personalised creations through originality, refined craftsmanship and thoughtful customisation. At PaperDreamz, we strive to turn every client's vision into a distinctive creation that reflects their individuality, exceeds ordinary expectations and makes every occasion more meaningful.
pillars.quote: We don't just create products; we give imagination a beautiful identity.

pillars.heading: Originality,
pillars.body: To establish PaperDreamz by Ruchi Mishra as a distinctive name in luxury paper artistry and customised creative design, inspiring crafters and designers across India and overseas through original concepts, trend-conscious innovation and uncompromising attention to detail. Beyond craft, our vision is to build a women-centric creative community that inspires independence, celebrates talent, and transforms creativity into a source of pride, purpose, and livelihood.
pillars.quote: To inspire creativity, empower women, set new standards and make originality timeless.

about.hero.eyebrow: Our Story · Paper Dreamz by Ruchi Mishra
about.hero.heading: Every beautiful thing begins with a dream.
about.hero.intro: From a small beginning in Delhi to a world of handcrafted elegance — a story shaped by imagination, patience, and thousands of little details that mean everything.

about.story.heading: Not just paper.
about.story.quote: Some businesses begin with capital. Some begin with opportunity. And some begin with a dream that refuses to remain small.
paragraphs: PaperDreamZ began nearly 17 years ago in Delhi, when **Ruchi Mishra** decided to turn her love for creativity into something meaningful. With a small fund to invest in a punching machine, she took her first step into a world that would gradually expand through tools, techniques, textures, colours, and countless ideas waiting to take shape.

There was no grand beginning. No extraordinary setup. Just a creative mind, the courage to begin with what was available, and the determination to make something beautiful out of something as simple as paper.
about.story.closing_text: That small beginning became a journey, and that journey became

about.journey.heading: From one machine to a
about.journey.intro: Our story was never about standing still. It was about discovering what more could be created, what more could be learned, and how far imagination could travel.

steps.title: The First Impression
steps.body: It started with a small investment in a punching machine — the first expressions of a creative vision.

steps.title: Precision & Quilling
steps.body: Cutting techniques and quilling opened new possibilities, transforming simple sheets into intricate handmade art.

steps.title: The Beauty of Framing
steps.body: Preserving creations with lasting presence, so that presentation makes people feel truly special.

steps.title: Tangible Memories
steps.body: Scrapbooks gave photographs, milestones and celebrations a permanent home beyond the moment.

steps.title: Cards, Invitations & Envelopes
steps.body: Greeting cards, invitations, envelopes and Shagun Lifafas became the signature of our journey. Every customised request challenged us to think differently — growing through continuous evolution without abandoning our roots.

about.envelopes.heading: Thousands of envelopes.
paragraphs: An envelope carries a wedding invitation, a blessing, a heartfelt message, or a gift presented with love. Held for moments before being opened, its impression remains long after.

Over the years, PaperDreamZ has created thousands of envelopes for client orders, each reflecting thoughtful design, presentation, and personalisation — from elegant Shagun Lifafas to invitation envelopes.
about.envelopes.quote: We see an envelope not as the end of a design process, but as the beginning of an experience.

about.promise.heading: Creativity is an ongoing
about.promise.intro: Between what a client imagines and what we thoughtfully bring to life. Our approach evolves through client feedback and experimentation.

steps.body: Every piece begins with what you imagine.
Textures, colours and techniques, tried and tested.
Your feedback shapes every detail and finish.
A beautiful new answer for what you need today.

about.world.heading: A handcrafted detail
about.world.intro: What began in Delhi gradually reached clients across India and international markets — Africa, the USA, Europe, Australia and Pacific nations. Different places bring diverse traditions and celebrations, yet the appreciation for thoughtfully designed craftsmanship remains universal.
about.world.closing_quote: A personalised envelope complements any meaningful celebration — wherever in the world it is opened.

about.happiness.heading: Client
paragraphs: There is something deeply special about receiving messages from clients who love what we have created. Testimonials and photographs from celebrations are reminders that creativity has a human purpose.
We cherish repeat orders and build lasting relationships, knowing that our clients do more than inspire our work — they help shape the future of PaperDreamZ.

about.next-chapter.heading: A destination for
about.next-chapter.body: Our next chapter elevates the art of envelopes — building PaperDreamZ into a distinctive luxury destination for refined styles, personalisation, and creations suited to life’s most meaningful occasions.
about.next-chapter.quote: We began with a small machine and a big dream. We continue with experience in our hands, gratitude in our hearts, and countless new ideas waiting to become reality.

about.personal-note.text: PaperDreamZ carries years of effort, learning, and the happiness of making something meaningful.
about.personal-note.accent: Thank you for being part of this story.
about.personal-note.tagline: Where Paper Finds Its Purpose, Details Find Their Beauty, and Every Occasion Finds Its Expression.

testimonials_section.heading: The Experience
testimonials_section.subtext: In the words of those who have gifted, celebrated and trusted us with their most special memories

testimonials.name: Shradha Inani
testimonials.highlight: Every single piece was absolutely perfect. The cuts were precise, the finishing was flawless, and not even one envelope was faulty.
testimonials.body:
Absolutely loved the customised envelopes made for my baby’s cradle ceremony! The attention to detail was incredible, and every single piece was absolutely perfect. The cuts were precise, the finishing was flawless, and not even one envelope was faulty.

Everyone who received them appreciated the beautiful work and kept asking where I got them from! So happy with the quality, creativity, and effort that went into making these. Highly recommend her for anyone looking for beautifully customised envelopes for special occasions. Thank you for making our celebration even more special!

testimonials.name: Rajani Todi
testimonials.highlight: The envelopes looked so pretty, more beautiful than it seemed on the screen, exactly as we had hoped.
testimonials.body:
We liked the envelope a lot in the starting when we saw that reel, it was something different and it was really beautiful but when it finally came to ordering it and that too such a bulk order we were scared of getting scammed, it happens a lot nowadays and with such a big order it was really scary for us, but we trusted her, of course after clearing our doubts and praying to God that everything will be good, but we were scared every day till the courier arrived.

Finally our courier arrived and the envelopes looked so pretty, more beautiful than it seemed on the screen, exactly as we had hoped, and our face lit up when we opened the courier. Everyone appreciated the envelope and asked where to buy it for themselves, it was one gift which was really amazing and successful.

testimonials.name: Sheenam
testimonials.highlight: When little details are done with perfection, it can be seen as a whole.
testimonials.body: I was actually quite sure about ordering with you, because when little details are done with perfection, it can be seen as a whole.

testimonials.name: Anju Sahni
testimonials.highlight: I truly appreciate how efficiently and carefully you managed everything. The product is absolutely lovely.
testimonials.body: Thank you so much for sending the parcel so promptly. I truly appreciate how efficiently and carefully you managed everything. The product is absolutely lovely, and I’m very happy with the quality. Thank you once again for the wonderful service and for making the whole experience so smooth.

testimonials.name: Anu
testimonials.highlight: Ruchi has a wonderful ability to turn memories and emotions into something tangible and beautiful. Her work is not just handmade; it is made from the heart.
testimonials.body:
I have had the pleasure of getting two very special creations made by Ruchi, and both were truly beautiful.

The first was a handmade baby album for my grandson. It was so pretty, unique and beautifully detailed that everyone who saw it kept asking me, “Who made this?” It was clearly made with so much love, patience and attention to detail.

I then got a special message card made for my mom’s 85th birthday, and honestly, it became one of the most meaningful gifts for her. It was personal, thoughtful and beautifully put together — something she will always treasure.

Ruchi has a wonderful ability to turn memories and emotions into something tangible and beautiful. Her work is not just handmade; it is made from the heart. I would highly recommend her to anyone looking for something truly personal and special.

testimonials.name: Uma Goel
testimonials.highlight: She instantly understands what I want, how I want and most importantly when I want. Never has she disappointed me.
testimonials.body: So I’ve known Ruchi since 15 years or so. Her consistency and professionalism impressed me the most. She instantly understands what I want, how I want and most importantly when I want because generally I am always in an urgency mode. But never has she disappointed me, be it with her neat work, or delivering it on time and just the thing I had imagined. Her soft attitude makes her very approachable and her work always makes me happy. Keep up your good work. Shine on.

testimonials.name: Renu
testimonials.highlight: They are beautifully designed, elegant, and look even more lovely in person. The quality and detailing are amazing.
testimonials.body: I absolutely loved the envelopes! They are beautifully designed, elegant, and look even more lovely in person. The quality and detailing are amazing. I’m really happy with them and would definitely recommend them to others. Thank you so much!

testimonials.name: A Cherished Patron
testimonials.highlight: Ruchi has made gifting something to a dear one a special moment for me. Each piece is so beautiful that sometimes it was difficult for me to part with them.
testimonials.body:
Ruchi has made gifting something to a dear one a special moment for me! I have had her put together a lot of stuff for my family and friends, who mean a lot to me and she has always made sure that each item turned out as beautiful and unique as I wanted them to.

She has even made things for me at such a short notice, that it was difficult to even imagine that was possible! The creativity and the passion with which she makes the books, frames, journals is really inspiring. Each piece is so beautiful that sometimes it was difficult for me to part with them and give them away.

She is a gem of a person, always forthcoming when it comes to guidance, any query regarding crafting, never shies away from sharing her knowledge, which makes her a great teacher! I have also undertaken many courses with her and it won’t be an exaggeration when I say that to find a better teacher in crafting than her won’t be possible.

Keep up the great work Ruchi, stay humble, stay your beautiful self. You already are and will always do wonders!

policies.title: Shipping & Delivery
policies.intro: Every order is handmade, packed by hand and shipped to every corner of India.

sections.heading: Processing time
sections.body:
Standard orders are processed within 7 working days of payment.

Bulk orders typically take around 3 weeks for processing and dispatch.

Timelines may vary slightly with design complexity and quantity — we will confirm the expected dispatch date when your order is confirmed.

sections.heading: Delivery
sections.body:
We deliver across India, from metros to the smallest towns. Once your order is dispatched we share the courier tracking details with you on WhatsApp.

Delivery time after dispatch depends on your location and the courier partner.

sections.heading: Shipping charges
sections.body: Shipping is complimentary on orders above the amount shown in the announcement bar at the top of our website. For smaller orders, shipping charges are shared with you before you confirm.

sections.heading: Urgent orders
sections.body: Need it sooner? Message us on WhatsApp before ordering and we will tell you honestly whether your date is possible.

policies.title: Returns & Refunds
policies.intro: Because every piece is handmade and customised for you, please read this before confirming your order.

sections.heading: Returns and exchanges
sections.body:
As every piece is handmade and customised specifically for you, we are unable to accept returns or exchanges.

We recommend reviewing your customisation details — names, dates, spellings, colours and quantities — carefully before confirming your order.

sections.heading: Damaged in transit
sections.body: We pack every order with care. If your parcel arrives damaged, please contact us on WhatsApp as soon as you receive it, with photos of the parcel and the product, so we can help.

sections.heading: Cancellations
sections.body: Production begins as soon as your payment is received, so orders cannot be cancelled once work has started.

policies.title: Terms & Conditions
policies.intro: The terms that apply when you order from Paper Dreamz by Ruchi Mishra.

sections.heading: Orders and payment
sections.body:
We require 100% advance payment to confirm an order; production begins as soon as payment is received.

Prices for bulk and customised orders are quoted individually, based on design and quantity.

sections.heading: Handmade products
sections.body:
Every piece is cut, assembled and finished by hand, so small variations in colour, texture and placement are part of its character and are not defects.

Colours may look slightly different on screen than in person.

sections.heading: Customisation
sections.body: You are responsible for checking names, dates, spellings and other customisation details before confirming. Pieces are made exactly as approved.

sections.heading: Designs and images
sections.body: All designs, photographs and content on this website belong to Paper Dreamz by Ruchi Mishra and may not be copied or reused without permission.

sections.heading: Shipping and returns
sections.body: Delivery, returns and cancellations are covered by our Shipping & Delivery and Returns & Refunds policies.

policies.title: Privacy Policy
policies.intro: How we handle the details you share with us.

sections.heading: What we collect
sections.body:
When you enquire or order, we collect the details you share with us — such as your name, phone number, email, delivery address and customisation details.

If you subscribe to our newsletter, we store your email address.

sections.heading: How we use it
sections.body:
We use your details only to respond to your enquiry, make and deliver your order, and — if you subscribed — send you occasional updates.

We share your delivery details with our courier partner only so that your order can reach you. We never sell your information.

sections.heading: Payments
sections.body: We do not store your card or bank details on this website.

sections.heading: Your choices
sections.body: You can ask us to update or delete your details, or unsubscribe from our newsletter, at any time by contacting us.
